title: Ray
summary: You spring the trap in aisle twenty-two and catch the stowaway: Ray. He confesses to living in the nest since October, looping camera six, and draining the generator so the lights wouldn't betray them from the road. Midway, he drops the real bomb — he used to work here, knew Dana before she was manager. At two in the morning, three heavy knocks hammer the buried bay door. Ray whispers the truck crew has arrived.

continuity_out: Night 2, 2:00 AM. Generator dead, store in total darkness lit only by three flashlights. Ray is caught, zip-tied, confessed: lived in nest since October, looped camera six, drained generator fuel to hide lights from the road. He reveals he was a night stocker here in 2019, knows Dana personally. Three heavy knocks just hit the buried bay door; metal screams as it's forced upward an inch. Ray whispers the truck crew has found them. Crew (you, Dana, Marcus) have three flashlights, bound Ray, bay door breaching.
